tools.name: list_clinics
tools.description: List the authenticated user's DoctoFam clinics with bounded, cursor-based pagination. Only non-clinical clinic metadata is returned.

tools.name: get_clinic
tools.description: Fetch safe metadata for one tenant-owned DoctoFam clinic. Only non-clinical clinic metadata is returned.

tools.name: get_clinic_schedule_summary
tools.description: Count scheduled records by UTC day for one tenant-owned DoctoFam clinic over a range of at most 31 days. Returns aggregate administrative counts only—never appointment identifiers or times, patient information, procedures, diagnoses, notes, or other clinical data.

tools.name: list_procedures
tools.description: List the authenticated user's DoctoFam procedure catalog with bounded pagination. Only catalog names, prices, durations, and edit times are returned; patient treatment data and record identifiers are excluded.

tools.name: list_rooms
tools.description: List administrative room names for one tenant-owned DoctoFam clinic with bounded pagination. Record identifiers, appointment links, patient information, and clinical content are excluded.

tools.name: list_calendar_events
tools.description: List tenant-scoped non-appointment calendar blocks (courses, meetings, days off, closures) with bounded pagination. Event identifiers, staff references, titles, and notes are never returned.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List display names for the bookable providers of one tenant-owned DoctoFam clinic. Contact details, role records, identifiers, and clinical data are never returned.

tools.name: get_clinic_availability
tools.description: List bookable appointment slots for one tenant-owned DoctoFam clinic. Only day, slot start, and slot end are returned—never patient, provider, or clinical data.

tools.name: get_subscription_status
tools.description: Get administrative plan status and entitlement limits for one tenant-owned DoctoFam clinic. Billing identifiers, payment-provider data, amounts, currencies, patient records, and clinical data are excluded.

tools.name: show_clinic_overview
tools.description: Render a bounded administrative overview for a known DoctoFam clinic. It combines safe clinic metadata, aggregate seven-day schedule counts, provider, room and availability counts, procedure-catalog previews, and plan entitlements. It never returns individual appointment records, patient information
